newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says Perez Companc pays $202 million for oil rights.
newsitem.headline: Peru says Perez Companc pays $202 million for oil rights.

text.p: Argentina's Compania Perez Companc Tuesday bought the rights at an auction to develop state-run Petroperu's oil Block X for $202 million, Peruvian privatisation officials said.

Perez Companc beat out four other bids from Houston-based Pennzoil Co., Canada's Norcen Energy Resources Ltd., China's CNPC America Peru SA, and a consortium 60 percent controlled by Argentina's Pluspetrol Corp. and 40 percent held by Peru's Grana y Montero Petrolera SA.

The closest rival bid to Perez Companc was that of CNPC, which offered $190 million to buy the block, which has proven reserves of 49 million barrels of crude oil and is located 720 miles north of Lima in the Talara region. Petroperu had set a $65 million minimum price bid for the block.
